cohort: smoke-v2 (a5b3687e), post hoc, evaluation-only GT used for this record only (never fed to control)
finding: 4 of 6 robot-episodes ended <leg>_no_path right after a progress-monitor stall recovery; the stall keep-out (0.20 m ahead, half 0.08 m) covered the leg goal or the door lane, so plan_path failed 3 times

stalls.leg: carry (loaded) to pre-place goal via door_1
stalls.why: robot held still ~306-313 s (looks/re-anchor) then drove 0.048 m/s; drive TIME since an old baseline passed 6 s; keep-out at (1.85, -0.09) in the door approach lane
slow crawl 0.07 m from the goal (small commands); keep-out at (-0.47, -2.613) covers the goal cell

stalls.leg: closer view toward a far_coarse cyan detection
stalls.why: same unseen green box jam as v1 (0.33, -1.61); v1 lost ~660 SIM s there, v2 failed at 80.9 s job time; keep-out (0.478, -1.444) covers the goal (0.438, -1.504)

stalls.leg: approach to the south approach point (-0.19, -1.37)
stalls.why: first: pushing against the target box itself (M1 _keepouts excludes the target); second: moving; keep-outs within 0.16 m of the goal

fix_v3: stall = commanded own displacement (sum |v_cmd| dt) >= 0.30 m since the trusted baseline while the trusted estimate moved < 0.10 m (was: 6 s of commanded-drive time)
no stall keep-out within 0.45 m of the leg goal or 0.60 m of a door centre (back off and re-look only)
a plan failure after a stall keep-out drops the stall keep-outs and re-plans; a leg that still cannot plan after a recovery ends 'blocked', not 'no_path'
